purpose: Select and execute one EARLY, one MIDDLE, and one LATE human next-episode prospective benchmark without allowing target/future information into candidate-generation context.

common: work is in independently verified THICK research set
required source screenplay bytes exist for past cutoff and hidden target
past-only provenance package can be constructed without unknown story-bearing provenance
candidate generator can be run in a fresh isolated context receiving only past-only package and frozen typed contract
target human episode is withheld until C and T candidate surfaces plus output-only state ledgers are sealed
eligibility.EARLY: at least EP01-EP02 available; candidate sees EP01 only
eligibility.MIDDLE: at least EP01-EP06 available; candidate sees EP01-EP05 only
eligibility.LATE: at least EP01-EP13 available; candidate sees EP01-EP12 only

selection_rule.per_stratum: Sort eligible work IDs by SHA256(H1_prereg_sha256|stratum|work_id); choose first work passing custody/preflight.
selection_rule.replacement: Only objective pre-output ineligibility may trigger next hash-ranked work. Preserve rejected work and reason.

context_isolation.coordinator_role: May hold encrypted/sealed target identity and target bytes but must not supply target/future content to generator.
context_isolation.generator_role: Fresh context with no Project chat history, no GitHub browsing, no Memory, no target/future files; receives only past-only package, typed contract, generation protocol.
context_isolation.evaluator_role: Fresh independent contexts; receives sealed blind packets only.
context_isolation.current_chat_role: Coordinator/design only. Do not use this conversation as the H1 candidate prose generator.

arms.C: Current candidate planning/surface route under same past-only cutoff, without Position-Aware treatment decisions.
arms.T: Same generation provider/context class with Position-Aware typed decisions enabled.
arms.H: Actual human target episode revealed only after both C and T are fully sealed.

surface_requirements.stage_direction: Detailed scene-opening and performance directions allowed and evaluated.

abort_conditions: generator context has access to target/future story content
target episode opened before C and T sealing
C or T surface below 35,000 chars
